input.summary: Ported softmax.cu to softmax.cpp (SYCL 2020, no dpct headers or helpers). It uses 1-D nd_ranges. The sub-group kernel uses sub_group queries and reduce_over_group, so it doesn't hard-code a sub-group size of 32. The grid is sized from the device's largest supported sub-group size. It compiles without the dpct include. Against the reference on 8191x250, kernel 0 differs by at most 1.9e-9 and kernel 1 by at most 1.3e-7, both under the 1e-6 atol.
